newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru shares bid-only on new restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru shares bid-only on new restructuring plan.

text.p: Shares in Kyotaru Co Ltd were bid-only on Friday morning, helped by growing expectations that the firm, which sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws last month, is likely to be restructured swiftly, traders said.
At 0123 GMT, the shares of the major restaurant chain operator were bid-only at 22 yen, against Thursday's 10 yen.

A Japanese financial daily said on Friday that 10 firms, including major food makers and trading firms, were interested in help restructure Kyotaru. A comment from Kyotaru was not immediatedly available.
